argv: with VoiceOver, then TalkBack, on, open What I'm into's page
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone, on an exploring walk, pull up the drawer, tap "What I’m into ›" under "Every walk", look at Back, then with VoiceOver on, focus it; repeat from the ready bar; then set the largest accessibility text size and open it from the walk again. **Expect:** from the walk Back reads "‹ Walk" and VoiceOver says "Walk, Back button"; from the ready bar it is as before; at the largest text size the arrow alone, still read as "Walk"; on Android the arrow alone in every case, the platform's own (`headerBackTitle` with `headerBackButtonDisplayMode`; What I'm into page review). (WI20)

argv: on an iPhone and on Android, open What I'm into's page and scroll it slowly
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone and on Android, open What I'm into's page and scroll slowly through History and Viewpoints & oddities. **Expect:** while a kind's indented rows pass under the pinned category heading, the heading's second line names that kind ("› Buildings and structures", "› Zoos and aquariums"); it goes when the kind's own row is in full under the heading; the heading never changes height and the rows never jump as the line comes and goes; the incoming heading pushes the last out, the second line with it (the native sticky header carries one level, the kind is the heading's words, set from `onScroll` in JS; What I'm into page review). (WI17)

argv: What I'm into page (the kind switches
ops.body: | What I'm into page (the kind switches leave the drawers: one row "What I’m into ›" in the ready bar's settings with Explore chosen and in the walk's drawer with Explore on, there in a short section of its own, "Every walk", pushes a page of its own with Back ("‹ Walk" from the walk), the same from both; the five categories' headings and Complexes' pinned while their rows scroll, the kind whose subtypes pass under a heading named as its second line; a kind's label heavier than its subtypes', a muted line naming the subtypes that are off; every switch saves as it changes; the walk goes on under it; WI1-WI25, decision 0192) | built 2026-11-18, test-first by history; the review's fixes built 2026-11-18; not deployed; native unverified | `claude/what-im-into-page` | `specs/what-im-into-page/spec.md` | not audited; cold find and UI review run Nov 18: four owner's calls and five local fixes, all fixed (WI17-WI25) |
